      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/23/tech-sell-off-ai-stock-market-support-measures-deployed-south-korea-taiwan-china-ftse-nasdaq-latest-news-updates</link>
      <description><p>New value still half a trillion dollars lower than before affair was revealed; Trump hails Huang as a ‘great patriot and national treasure’</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/23/jensen-huang-reinstated-as-nvidia-chief-executive">Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2026/nov/12/jensen-huang-affair-timeline">Timeline: fall and comeback of Jensen Huang<br></a></p></li></ul><p><strong>Shares in UK housebuilder Crest Nicholson have slumped by a quarter, to a record low, after the company issued a profits warning this morning.</strong></p><p>Full year completions were 1,353, at the bottom end of the Group’s previous guidance range of 1,350 to 1,400 completions.</p><p>The warning has hammered Crest Nicholson shares, which have lost more than a quarter of their value this morning, currently trading down over 30%. The brutal sell-off is also weighing on the wider sector, dragging peers like Barratt Redrow, Persimmon, Vistry and Bellway into the red.</p><p>Today’s update suggests that weakness in the housing market is no longer confined to first-time buyers. Crest Nicholson is predominantly exposed to the mid-premium family housing market, and the sharp deterioration in sales rates indicates that more affluent upsizers are also becoming increasingly cautious amid macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/live/2026/nov/23/tech-sell-off-ai-stock-market-support-measures-deployed-south-korea-taiwan-china-ftse-nasdaq-latest-news-updates">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/22/jensen-huang-nvidia-john-kennedy</link>
      <description><p>John Kennedy looks to Trump leaders as he asks how China evidently bypassed export controls for Nvidia’s top AI chips</p><p>Invoking Greek mythology, the US senator John Kennedy has characterized former <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/nvidia">Nvidia</a> chief executive officer <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/technology/jensen-huang">Jensen Huang</a>’s reported affair with a suspected Chinese spy as “the <a href="https://x.com/atrupar/status/2124514031209980207?a=ArDF3m1PBQGZjNDPrME&amp;s=20">most expensive</a> sex since Helen of Troy”.</p><p>The Louisiana Republican’s allusion to the legendary figure whose desirability was such that it caused the mythic Trojan war came during an interview on NBC’s Meet the Press on Sunday.
